title: Logiciels
description: Software of this computer: counts by source; pending updates (Linux: distribution packages from the local cache and Flatpak; Windows: last Windows Update search and install dates) and whether a restart is required; recent update history (Windows Update, dnf / apt transactions); programs started automatically at logon with their state; language runtimes (.NET, .NET Framework, Java, Python, Node.js, PowerShell, Go, Rust, PHP, Ruby, Visual C++ redistributables); installed browsers, their versions and the default browser; Windows and Office activation status (never the key); software past or near its end of support; and the installed applications (Windows programs, Linux desktop applications from packages, Flatpak and Snap). Findings flag pending updates, updates not installed for a long time, a pending restart, end-of-life software, broken startup entries and inactive licenses.

functions.name: list
functions.title: Logiciels installés
functions.help: Liste les logiciels installés selon la source (applications, Store, paquets, Flatpak, Snap), filtrés par texte et triés par nom, date ou taille.
functions.description: Installed software of this computer, filtered and sorted: name, version, publisher or source, install date, size and scope. Sources: applications (Windows programs from the uninstall registry; Linux desktop applications from packages, Flatpak, Snap and the user), store (Microsoft Store apps), packages (every Linux distribution package), flatpak, snap, or all.

parameters.name: source
parameters.label: Source
parameters.description: applications, store (Windows), packages (Linux distribution packages), flatpak, snap, or all.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.label: Texte
parameters.description: Keep only software whose name, publisher or description contains this text (case-insensitive).

parameters.name: sortBy
parameters.label: Tri
parameters.description: Sort by name, install date (newest first) or size (largest first).

functions.name: get_pending_updates
functions.title: Mises à jour en attente
functions.help: Recherche les mises à jour disponibles (Windows Update et winget ; dnf, apt, Flatpak sous Linux), en signalant les mises à jour de sécurité. Tâche longue ; « Actualiser les dépôts » interroge Internet d'abord.
functions.description: Updates available for this computer, with name, installed and new version, source and whether it is a security update. Windows: an online Windows Update search (can take a minute) plus winget upgrades if winget is installed. Linux: dnf, apt or pacman packages (with security advisories on dnf), Flatpak and Snap. With refresh, Linux package metadata is downloaded first instead of using the local cache.

parameters.name: refresh
parameters.label: Actualiser les dépôts
parameters.description: Linux: refresh the repository metadata before checking (slower, needs network). Windows always searches online.

functions.name: get_update_history
functions.title: Historique des mises à jour
functions.help: Historique des installations et mises à jour sur la période, avec les échecs. « Détail des paquets » limite le nombre de paquets listés par opération.
functions.description: Update and install history of this computer over the last days: Windows Update operations with result and KB, installed hotfixes; dnf transactions (with the packages changed by the latest ones) or apt history on Linux.

parameters.name: top
parameters.label: Opérations affichées (les plus récentes)
parameters.description: Maximum number of operations or transactions returned.

parameters.name: details
parameters.label: Détail des paquets
parameters.description: Linux: list the packages changed by this many most recent transactions.

functions.name: set_startup
functions.title: Programme au démarrage
functions.help: Active ou désactive un programme lancé à l'ouverture de session (nom tel qu'affiché dans la page Logiciels). Pris en compte à la prochaine ouverture de session ; annulable.
functions.description: Enables or disables one program started automatically at logon, without uninstalling it (reversible with the same action). Windows: the StartupApproved flag, as Task Manager does (Run keys and Startup folders; entries for all users need administrator rights). Linux: XDG autostart entries, through a copy in ~/.config/autostart with Hidden=true/false (system files are never changed), or systemd --user units (enable / disable). Takes effect at the next logon; the program is neither started nor stopped now. Use the names listed in get_software (Programmes au démarrage).

parameters.name: name
parameters.label: Programme
parameters.description: Name of the startup item as listed by get_software (Windows: Run value or shortcut name; Linux: application name, .desktop file name or systemd --user unit).

parameters.name: enabled
parameters.label: Activé
parameters.description: true to start it at logon, false to stop starting it.

functions.name: install_updates
functions.title: Installer les mises à jour
functions.help: Installe les mises à jour en attente (toutes ou seulement celles de sécurité). Action critique et longue : point de restauration avant, redémarrage parfois nécessaire.
functions.description: Installs the pending updates. scope system: Windows Update (download and install through the Windows Update agent) or the Linux package manager (dnf upgrade, with --security when securityOnly; apt-get upgrade; pacman -Syu); flatpak: flatpak update (Linux); winget: winget upgrade --all (Windows); all: everything. The preview lists the updates (Linux: from the local repository cache). Can take up to an hour; a restart may be needed after.

parameters.name: securityOnly
parameters.label: Sécurité seulement
parameters.description: Only security updates (Windows Update and dnf).

functions.name: uninstall
functions.title: Désinstaller un logiciel
functions.help: Désinstalle un logiciel (nom tel qu'affiché dans la liste). Action critique : point de restauration avant ; les données de l'utilisateur peuvent être conservées ou non selon le logiciel.
functions.description: Uninstalls one program. Windows: its silent uninstall command, msiexec /x for MSI products, winget, or as a last resort its own uninstaller (a window the user must follow). Linux: dnf / apt-get / pacman remove for a package, flatpak uninstall, snap remove. The preview shows the method and, for packages, the other packages removed with it; never essential system packages. Use names from software_list.

parameters.name: name
parameters.label: Logiciel
parameters.description: Exact name (or package / application id) as listed by software_list.

parameters.name: source
parameters.label: Source
parameters.description: Restrict the search: program (Windows), package, flatpak, snap, or auto.
